Indore water tragedy: Congress demands FIR, mayor's resignation

Following the Indore water tragedy, the Congress party has demanded an FIR and the resignation of the mayor. A panel investigating the incident flagged lapses in the pipeline, with Congress also seeking answers regarding missing records and delays in the process.
